newsitem.title: USA: PremiumWear names president, adopts rights plan.
newsitem.headline: PremiumWear names president, adopts rights plan.

text.p: PremiumWear Inc said Monday its directors elected David Berg to the additional post of president. Berg, 40, had been executive vice president and chief operating officer.

Separately, PremiumWear said its directors also adopted a new shareholder rights plan designed to insure that all of the company's shareholders receive fair and equal treatment in the event of any proposal to acquire the company.
PremiumWear, which markets Munsingwear brand knit shirts and other apparel, said it is not aware of any current attempt to take control of the company.
The position of president had been vacant since September 1996.
The shareholder rights plan will replace PremiumWear's present rights plan, which expires in November 1997.

The company's board declared a distribution of one right for each share of common stock outstanding on November 12, 1997. Each right entitles the holder to purchase 1/100th of a share of a new series of Junior Participating Preferred Stock of PremiumWear at an initial exercise price of $32.00.

The rights can be exercised when a person or group, without the prior consent of the PremiumWear board, acquires 15 percent or more of the company's voting stock. They can also be triggered following announcement of a tender offer or exchange offer to acquire an interest of 15 percent or more of the company's stock.
In certain specified instances, the rights may be redeemed by the company. If not redeemed, they would expire on November 12, 2007.

"The Plan was adopted after extensive consideration by the board to replace our old plan expiring in November 1997 and is intended to continue to protect the interests of our shareholders in the event of abusive or unfair take-over tactics," said Thomas Gleason, Chief Executive Officer of PremiumWear. "It is not designed to prevent the acquisition of the company on terms beneficial to all shareholders," he added in a news release.
